info.name: Nearby Teacher — App Team API
info.description: Nearby Teacher App Team API, updated 22 October 2026. Exactly five workflow folders: Auth, Learner, Teacher, Institute, Common. Read docs/APP_TEAM_API.md. Default baseUrl includes /nearby_teachers/public; there is no /api prefix. All registered application JSON APIs and health/location/broadcast compatibility surfaces are included; ordinary developer/admin HTML pages are not API requests. Admin JSON routes are restricted under Common > Admin only. Shared endpoint copies in Teacher/Institute describe role payloads, not additional routes or invented role restrictions. Select requests individually; running the full collection performs conflicting signup roles and state changes. Set credentials and real IDs manually. Normal OTP request/verify are No Auth; Google OTP request/verify require authMethod=google and the Google-linked Laravel bearer. Save the fresh OTP verification token for the same user. Normal registration requires email/password; Google-linked registration may omit them. Student form submission returns 200 with registrationSubmitted=true, registrationCompleted=false and nextScreen=age_verification until separate DOB and required parent approval succeed. Teacher/institute require no DOB. Existing database values restore through GET /auth/onboarding; no pre-registration autosave was added. Route by nextScreen, including guardian_consent. Correct password on incomplete registration returns 409 with no token. Logout invalidates all API sessions and clears this collection token; Firebase global refresh-token revocation is not performed. All saved examples are fictional, based on controller response shapes, never live server captures. Fictional tokens are unusable. Production SMS/email codes must be supplied manually. Deploy migrations 000031/000032 with current code. Role folder coverage includes all shared participant chat/replies, feed offers or requests, comments and explicit replies, likes, booking status and safety acknowledgement. Teacher/institute can reply to existing participant conversations; only learners can start in-app conversations. Call/WhatsApp actions use returned provider phone from the quota-controlled profile lookup and frontend tel:/wa.me links; no dedicated call/WhatsApp API exists. The collection includes shared endpoint variants and fictional saved examples; Database-backed presence lifecycle requests are under Common; no Redis is needed for presence. See docs/PRESENCE.md. The named chat APIs require migration 000033; see docs/CHAT_EVENTS.md.
